title: B2B Buyers Want More Thought Leadership as AI Spreads

hero.caption: of B2B buyers
hero.label: value thought leadership more as AI spreads
hero.alt: 82% of B2B decision-makers say thought leadership is becoming more valuable as AI floods content with generic material. Source: Edelman/LinkedIn 2026 B2B Thought Leadership Impact Report.

visuals.after_heading: What the Edelman and LinkedIn report actually found
visuals.headline: Weak thought leadership has a real cost
visuals.source: Source: Edelman/LinkedIn, 2026 B2B Thought Leadership Impact Report
visuals.alt: 59% of final decision-makers say weak thought leadership helped remove a vendor from consideration; 48% say it shaped their initial shortlist. Source: Edelman/LinkedIn.

visuals.after_heading: The AI paradox: more automation, less tolerance for generic content
visuals.headline: 84% of buyers now use AI to summarise vendor content
visuals.source: Source: Edelman/LinkedIn, 2026 B2B Thought Leadership Impact Report
visuals.alt: 84% of B2B buyers used an AI tool to summarise a vendor's thought leadership during evaluation. Source: Edelman/LinkedIn.

visuals.after_heading: Why buyers still want a human behind the thinking
visuals.name: Victoria Whitney
visuals.text: In an AI-driven world, information is everywhere. Credible insight grounded in real expertise carries greater weight.
visuals.source: Source: Edelman/LinkedIn, 2026 B2B Thought Leadership Impact Report
visuals.alt: Victoria Whitney, VP of Corporate Communications at Ecolab, says credible insight grounded in real expertise carries more weight in an AI-driven world. Source: Edelman/LinkedIn.

visuals.after_heading: What this means for your team's content, starting this week
visuals.headline: Four moves backed by the data above

items.title: Name one problem
items.text: Write to one buyer's specific challenge, not the market.

items.title: Name the person
items.text: A signed stance beats unsigned brand copy.

items.title: Fewer, sharper pieces
items.text: One piece a month that earns a share beats a weekly rehash.

items.title: Keep going post-sale
items.text: 7 in 10 buyers say it matters more after they've bought.

visuals.source: Source: Edelman/LinkedIn, 2026 B2B Thought Leadership Impact Report
visuals.alt: Four content moves backed by the Edelman/LinkedIn 2026 report: name one problem, name the person, write fewer sharper pieces, and keep going after the sale.
